replacements.instruction: Define W/L/T and the win-rate denominator for system pairwise comparisons where the notation is first introduced, without changing the two-order consistency rule.
replacements.before: Headline win rates are computed over these order-consistent comparisons.
replacements.after: We report each system contrast as wins/losses/ties (W/L/T) for the first-named system and compute its win rate over non-tied order-consistent outcomes as $W/(W+L)$.

replacements.instruction: Clarify that the output-length sensitivity table uses W/L/T from the longer-response perspective, which differs from the first-named-system convention for system contrasts.
replacements.before: W/L/T combines the two presentation orders for each prompt; ties are excluded from the longer-side win-rate denominator.
replacements.after: Here, W/L/T denotes wins/losses/ties for the longer response after applying the two-order consistency rule; ties are excluded from the longer-side win-rate denominator.
